incidental_defect.finding: train_v6_staged.py:10371 prints refusals as f'[v6] ⛔ {p}'. On a cp1252 console this raises UnicodeEncodeError, so the trainer CRASHES INSTEAD OF PRINTING THE REFUSAL -- hiding exactly the diagnostic a launch needs. Workaround: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8. Durable fix: ASCII refusal text or an explicit UTF-8 stream.
